Bill.BriefDescription: Encouraging use of dispute resolution services for homeowners' associations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to dispute resolution services for homeowners'associations; and adding a new section to chapter 64.38 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 64.38 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A homeowners' association or an owner may use alternative disputeresolution services to resolve any controversy arising under theprovisions of this chapter.
